gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-79.405425 38.70907)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] > 1200 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

),
higher_raster_points AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Clip(rast, 1, ST_Buffer(p.geom::geometry, 0.01), true))).geom AS geom
  FROM
    public.dem_us,
    poi_geom p

    ST_Intersects(rast, p.geom::geometry)
    AND (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Clip(rast, 1, ST_Buffer(p.geom::geometry, 0.01), true))).val > 1200
)
SELECT
  MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom, h.geom::geography)) AS distance_meters
FROM
  poi_geom p,
  higher_raster_points h;
